terminus.finding: A Drive folder named『還算有用的作業』contains prior human curation that is itself useful metadata, but it should only act as a weak prior, not a verdict. The Saussure note is strong mining material because it cleanly separates summary from discussion and then independently connects sign/value/system/relative position to Lacan, suture and lack. The Jameson report cannot yet receive a confident quality score because legacy text encoding is degraded and authorship is not secure.
terminus.methodCorrection: Provenance and quality are now independent axes. Third-party or student material is not excluded; it can be high-value ore. Likewise, user-authored material is not automatically high quality. Existing folder-level human curation can raise sampling priority but machine judgment still evaluates argument clarity, evidence, conceptual precision, originality, and reusable fragments.
terminus.candidate: The Saussure note strengthens a long-running system/position/value thread without relying on third-party material: value is relational within a system, and the later discussion asks how an arbitrary sign system becomes temporarily sutured. This is compatible with older representation/lack lines but is not yet promoted to a single master theory.
terminus.next: sample one clearly student-authored document and one third-party reference from different topics, then compare quality independent of authorship
